_note: Festivals (src/core/festivals.js): the last day of every game week, cycling through this list by week. Clip ids: fest-<key>-<person> for greetings and replies (once per townsperson voice), fest-<key> for the teacher's noticeboard lines, fest-riddle-<n> for riddles. Riddle parts need no clip.

reply-chunjie.zh: 恭喜发财！这是给你的红包。
reply-chunjie.pinyin: Gōngxǐ fācái! Zhè shì gěi nǐ de hóngbāo.
reply-chunjie.en: Wishing you prosperity! Here's a red envelope for you.

about-chunjie.zh: 今天是春节，大家一起吃饺子、贴春联。
about-chunjie.pinyin: Jīntiān shì Chūnjié, dàjiā yìqǐ chī jiǎozi, tiē chūnlián.
about-chunjie.en: Today is Spring Festival: everyone eats dumplings and puts up spring couplets.

about-yuanxiao.zh: 今天是元宵节，晚上可以看花灯、猜灯谜。
about-yuanxiao.pinyin: Jīntiān shì Yuánxiāojié, wǎnshang kěyǐ kàn huādēng, cāi dēngmí.
about-yuanxiao.en: Today is the Lantern Festival: in the evening you can see the lanterns and guess lantern riddles.

about-duanwu.zh: 今天是端午节，大家吃粽子、看龙舟。
about-duanwu.pinyin: Jīntiān shì Duānwǔjié, dàjiā chī zòngzi, kàn lóngzhōu.
about-duanwu.en: Today is the Dragon Boat Festival: everyone eats zongzi and watches the dragon boats.

about-zhongqiu.zh: 今天是中秋节，晚上一起吃月饼、看月亮。
about-zhongqiu.pinyin: Jīntiān shì Zhōngqiūjié, wǎnshang yìqǐ chī yuèbǐng, kàn yuèliang.
about-zhongqiu.en: Today is the Mid-Autumn Festival: in the evening we eat mooncakes and look at the moon.

riddles.parts: 木 + 木 + 木 = 森
人 + 人 + 人 = 众

riddles.pinyin: Yí ge rén kàozhe yì kē shù
riddles.en: A person leaning on a tree

riddles.pinyin: Yì kǒu yǎo diào niú wěiba
riddles.en: One bite takes off the cow's tail
riddles.parts: 牛（去掉尾巴）+ 口 = 告
